_contract: One staging run: the campaign's verified probes copied onto a provider network volume and re-hashed from the bytes that landed there. This is transport infrastructure. It admits nothing into the experiment — a continuation still re-identifies every probe against the identity its campaign announced, on the pod that consumes it.

volume._need_is_a_total_not_an_increment: need is the final size of this campaign's staged tree. A probe already on the volume is part of that total, not an addition to it, so a resumed draw is charged nothing for what it will skip.
volume._df_is_not_the_quota: df at the mount reports the backing cluster, not this volume's quota, so capacity comes from the provisioned size the provider sold

transport_floor._observed_is_diagnostic: one observation of a rate that moves. It is recorded, and it is never promoted into a schedule or a bound.

_why_stopped: stopped on the maintainer's 2026-09-23 standing rule that artifacts follow consumers rather than campaigns. Eight of the ten completed probes had already been transferred; the remaining two were completed and validly scored, so no remaining authorized operation reads their weights and there was nothing to justify moving them. The eight are sunk operational cost, may stay on the volume until teardown, and are NOT a required input by virtue of being present. What a continuation reads instead is 8.1 MiB of descriptors, scores, per-sample rows and hashes -- 0.035% of the bytes -- copied fresh from the launcher host.
_what_is_on_the_volume: eight completed probes plus a partial ninth. None is a dependency: volume_gate asks only for probes whose WEIGHTS a remaining operation reads, and this campaign has none.

teardown.how: terminated out of band when the run was stopped, and confirmed by polling until the provider reported no pods; the run's own finally block did not execute

money._gpu_usd_not_self_reported: this run was stopped before it could compute its own elapsed cost. The authoritative figure for the whole durable-staging campaign is the provider balance delta, booked in campaign.json.
